name: Bridge
summary: 700 real tutoring conversations with 1st to 5th graders that end in a math mistake, each annotated by expert teachers with the error, a remediation strategy and an expert's reply.

license.note: The GitHub LICENSE is MIT, for the software; the Hugging Face card says CC BY-NC 4.0, so treat the data as non-commercial.

cite: Wang, R. E., Zhang, Q., Robinson, C., Loeb, S., & Demszky, D. (2024). Bridging the Novice-Expert Gap via Models of Decision-Making: A Case Study on Remediating Math Mistakes. NAACL 2024. https://doi.org/10.18653/v1/2024.naacl-long.120

fits.how: Its experts' replies and strategies could be the reference a judge compares an agent's reply to a mistake against, for non-commercial use, given whole sessions.

connect.note: Comes down as its JSON. Each transcript is four turns long and the problem is often on a picture the text doesn't hold, so as test cases they would test little; MathDial and MRBench are connected instead. Non-commercial: asks you to accept its license first.
